en: The ghost can't be made out. Without some way of seeing it, there's no going on.
text: Fantoma nu se poate desluși. Fără un mijloc de a o vedea, nu se poate merge mai departe.

en: The Silph Scope shows the ghost for what it is: a Marowak!
The ghost was the spirit of Cubone's mother, Marowak.
The mother's spirit was calmed. It went away to rest at last...
